name: r3_erdos_szekeres
statement: (r s : ℕ) (f : Fin (r * s + 1) → ℝ) (hf : Function.Injective f) : (∃ t : Finset (Fin (r * s + 1)), r < t.card ∧ StrictMonoOn f (t : Set (Fin (r * s + 1)))) ∨ (∃ t : Finset (Fin (r * s + 1)), s < t.card ∧ StrictAntiOn f (t : Set (Fin (r * s + 1))))
closed: ∀ (r s : ℕ) (f : Fin (r * s + 1) → ℝ) (hf : Function.Injective f), (∃ t : Finset (Fin (r * s + 1)), r < t.card ∧ StrictMonoOn f (t : Set (Fin (r * s + 1)))) ∨ (∃ t : Finset (Fin (r * s + 1)), s < t.card ∧ StrictAntiOn f (t : Set (Fin (r * s + 1))))
informal: Erdős–Szekeres: any sequence of rs+1 distinct reals has an increasing subsequence of length r+1 or a decreasing one of length s+1. Proof idea: label each index i with (length of longest increasing subsequence ending at i, longest decreasing ending at i); labels are pairwise distinct (for i<j one of the two coordinates strictly grows); if all labels lay in [1,r]×[1,s] pigeonhole would be violated.
type: ∀ (r s : ℕ) (f : Fin (r * s + 1) → ℝ), Function.Injective f → (∃ t, r < t.card ∧ StrictMonoOn f ↑t) ∨ ∃ t, s < t.card ∧ StrictAntiOn f ↑t

theorem r3_erdos_szekeres (r s : ℕ) (f : Fin (r * s + 1) → ℝ) (hf : Function.Injective f) : (∃ t : Finset (Fin (r * s + 1)), r < t.card ∧ StrictMonoOn f (t : Set (Fin (r * s + 1)))) ∨ (∃ t : Finset (Fin (r * s + 1)), s < t.card ∧ StrictAntiOn f (t : Set (Fin (r * s + 1)))) := by
  have labels : ∀ (n : ℕ) (g : Fin n → ℝ), ∃ a : Fin n → ℕ, (∀ i, 1 ≤ a i ∧ ∃ t : Finset (Fin n), t.card = a i ∧ StrictMonoOn g (t : Set (Fin n))) ∧ ∀ i j, i < j → g i < g j → a i < a j := by
    clear hf f r s
    sorry
  have pigeon : ∀ (r s : ℕ) (a b : Fin (r * s + 1) → ℕ), (∀ i, 1 ≤ a i ∧ a i ≤ r) → (∀ i, 1 ≤ b i ∧ b i ≤ s) → ∃ i j, i < j ∧ a i = a j ∧ b i = b j := by
    clear labels hf f r s
    sorry
  by_contra hcon
  push_neg at hcon
  obtain ⟨hinc, hdec⟩ := hcon
  obtain ⟨a, ha1, ha2⟩ := labels _ f
  obtain ⟨b, hb1, hb2⟩ := labels _ (fun i => - f i)
  have hA : ∀ i, 1 ≤ a i ∧ a i ≤ r := by
    intro i
    obtain ⟨h1, t, ht, hmono⟩ := ha1 i
    refine ⟨h1, ?_⟩
    by_contra hc
    exact hinc t (by omega) hmono
  have hB : ∀ i, 1 ≤ b i ∧ b i ≤ s := by
    intro i
    obtain ⟨h1, t, ht, hmono⟩ := hb1 i
    refine ⟨h1, ?_⟩
    by_contra hc
    refine hdec t (by omega) ?_
    intro x hx y hy hxy
    have := hmono hx hy hxy
    simp only at this
    linarith
  obtain ⟨i, j, hij, hae, hbe⟩ := pigeon r s a b hA hB
  have hne : f i ≠ f j := fun h => (ne_of_lt hij) (hf h)
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hne with h | h
  · have := ha2 i j hij h; omega
  · have := hb2 i j hij (neg_lt_neg h); omega

∀ (r s : ℕ) (a b : Fin (r * s + 1) → ℕ), (∀ (i : Fin (r * s + 1)), 1 ≤ a i ∧ a i ≤ r) → (∀ (i : Fin (r * s + 1)), 1 ≤ b i ∧ b i ≤ s) → ∃ (i : Fin (r * s + 1)) (j : Fin (r * s + 1)), i < j ∧ a i = a j ∧ b i = b j
